title: Read a JSON body
summary: Spring Boot: Read a JSON body. Change the posted title.
introduction: @RequestBody reads JSON into a Java record. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
learningObjectives: Read a JSON body with Spring Boot

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.

blocks.title: Read a JSON body

blocks.text: The JSON title is bound to the record field. Returning the record serialises that field again.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A record defines fields but does not automatically make every value valid.

seo.title: Spring Boot: Read a JSON body
seo.description: Spring Boot: Read a JSON body. Change the posted title. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
